description: This file contains CMake script functions and variable definitions for selecting CUDA compute architecture flags, detecting installed GPUs, and managing CUDA architecture lists based on CUDA version. It is used for configuring CUDA compilation settings in a build system.

methods.name: CUDA_SELECT_NVCC_ARCH_FLAGS
methods.description: Selects GPU architecture flags for nvcc based on provided architecture list or autodetection.

methods.name: CUDA_DETECT_INSTALLED_GPUS
methods.description: Detects installed GPU architectures using CUDA runtime and sets output variable.
